import csv
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
from collections import defaultdict

rate = Decimal("0.92")
seen = set()
totals = defaultdict(Decimal)
with open("expenses.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        if row["id"] in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(row["id"])
        cat = row["category"]
        if cat == "privé":
            continue
        amt = Decimal(row["amount"].strip().replace(",", "."))
        if row["currency"] == "USD":
            amt = amt * rate
        elif row["currency"] != "EUR":
            raise SystemExit("unknown currency " + row["currency"])
        totals[(row["date"][:7], cat)] += amt

with open("summary.csv", "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f, lineterminator="\n")
    w.writerow(["month", "category", "total_eur"])
    for (m, c) in sorted(totals):
        t = totals[(m, c)].quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
        w.writerow([m, c, f"{t:.2f}"])
EOF
python3 -I /tmp/psz-work/scratch/summarize.py && cat summary.csv
